apps.versionDescription: Monumental v2.0.0 milestone. Complete multiplatform rewrite powered by Avalonia 12 and .NET 10. Direct in-process Rust FFI core (dnglab_ffi), PhotoKit library integration, 800+ cameras supported, and direct export to Adobe Lightroom Mobile.
apps.localizedDescription: Transform your iPhone, iPad, and mirrorless RAW photos with genuine Fujifilm color science. Fujifier injects authentic Fujifilm camera calibration and film simulation profiles (Provia, Velvia, Astia, Classic Chrome, Classic Neg, Nostalgic Neg, Eterna, ACROS, and Reala Ace) into camera RAW and DNG files. Features Metal acceleration, full dynamic range preservation, and direct 1-tap export to Adobe Lightroom Mobile.
